files.README.md:
Mereside Marina pump-out station, May 2026 export.

A status of void means the booking was cancelled and the boat never tied
up; only done services are billable. The TOTAL line at the bottom counts
every row in the file, whatever its status.

turns.prompt: Mereside Marina's May pump-out export is due for the harbor board pack. Summarize it for me: how many pump-outs were completed, which berth needed the most visits, and what the void bookings amount to.
